session_summary: Evaluated state transitions and edge-case behaviors on the Ember Forge route. Confirmed successful route completion, coin collection telemetry, and obstacle interaction handling, noting repetitive input locking against active obstacles.

observations.evidence: Telemetry shows two consecutive 'obstacle_hit' events at step 2 (`from_step: 2, to_step: 2`) with duplicate 'The obstacle blocks walking. Use Jump.' messages before the player successfully issued a Jump action.
observations.recommendation: Implement input command buffering or automatic action switching when a walk command is received against a blocked state to prevent redundant error spam.

bugs.title: Redundant Walk Commands Do Not Increment Step Counter on Blocked Obstacle
repro_steps: Walk forward until reaching an obstacle at step 2
Issue multiple walk commands without jumping
bugs.expected: Player position remains stable or movement command is rejected gracefully without duplicate message stacking.
bugs.observed: Multiple walk commands are accepted by the input parser while the player is blocked, resulting in duplicate error messages at step 2 (`from_step: 2, to_step: 2`) before jumping.

feature_requests.title: Input Buffering for Obstacle Interaction
feature_requests.player_value: Improves responsiveness and reduces frustration when players press movement keys rapidly near obstacles.
feature_requests.rationale: Edge-case testing shows players frequently attempt to keep walking into obstacles before realizing a jump is required.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Automatically buffer or prompt the correct jump input when a walk action is entered against a known hazard.

keep: Clean route completion handling and reward allocation (+25 coins on Ember Forge completion).
Accurate telemetry tracking for obstacle hits, jumps, and coin collections.
focus: state transitions, repeatability, blocking states, exploit risks and regressions
